name: Are there hidden costs associated with building a tiny home?

mainEntity.name: Are there hidden costs associated with building a tiny home?

acceptedAnswer.text: While we strive for transparency, some costs might not be immediately obvious. Potential 'hidden' costs include site preparation (clearing land, grading), utility hookups (water, sewer/septic, electricity, internet), transportation for a tiny home on wheels to its final location, and foundation work for a permanent structure. Permit fees, impact fees, and property taxes, which vary by location, are also important considerations. It's crucial to discuss all potential expenses with your builder to get a comprehensive understanding.
acceptedAnswer.description: Potential hidden costs include site preparation, utility hookups, transportation, foundation work, and various local permit and property fees.
